turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me before Owen's zero went in.
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Record it. I'll want a copy, and I'll be taking my own notes. Now, who decided on the zero?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
Nobody has mentioned legal action, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and I still haven't been answered.
I'll choose them carefully. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
